title: Escape a Large Maze
goal: Decide whether a route exists on a huge grid where only a few cells are blocked.
strategy: A region enclosed by k walls holds at most k(k − 1)/2 cells, so two limited searches are enough.

phasePurposes.inspect: Expand from one end within the limit.

inputRules: The input parser enforces the problem domain and explicit limits for an inspectable trace.
